text:
Lancaster Elementary sees 15 5th-graders take science MCA in 2024-25
Fifth-grade students were the sole participants in the science portion of the 2024-25 MCA at Lancaster Elementary School, as reported by the Minnesota Department of Education.
There were 15 fifth-grade students who completed this section of the MCA at Lancaster Elementary School.
According to the assessment, 27% of the fifth-grade students were deemed proficient in science under the established test criteria.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are standardized state tests measuring student achievement against Minnesota’s academic standards and fulfill federal and state legislative requirements. The exams evaluate students in math, reading, and science, depending on the grade level. The majority of students take the MCA, while the Alt MCA is available for students receiving special education services who meet eligibility standards.
According to Minnesota's Report Card, proficiency rates on Minnesota's MCA assessments have dropped from pre-pandemic levels. Math proficiency declined by more than 7% since 2019, and reading proficiency fell by nearly 5%.
Details for this article were sourced from the Minnesota Department of Education. Data can be accessed here.
